SELECT 
    cd_gender, 
    cd_marital_status, 
    cd_education_status, 
    COUNT(*) AS cnt1, 
    cd_purchase_estimate, 
    COUNT(*) AS cnt2, 
    cd_credit_rating, 
    COUNT(*) AS cnt3 
FROM 
    customer c 
    INNER JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk 
    INNER JOIN customer_demographics cd ON cd.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk 
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT ss.ss_customer_sk
        FROM store_sales ss
        INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
    ) AS store_sales_filtered ON c.c_customer_sk = store_sales_filtered.ss_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
        FROM web_sales ws
        INNER JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
    ) AS web_sales_filtered ON c.c_customer_sk = web_sales_filtered.ws_bill_customer_sk
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT cs.cs_ship_customer_sk
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        INNER JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
        WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 3
    ) AS catalog_sales_filtered ON c.c_customer_sk = catalog_sales_filtered.cs_ship_customer_sk
WHERE 
    ca.ca_state IN ('IL','TX','ME') 
    AND web_sales_filtered.ws_bill_customer_sk IS NULL
    AND catalog_sales_filtered.cs_ship_customer_sk IS NULL
GROUP BY 
    cd_gender, 
    cd_marital_status, 
    cd_education_status, 
    cd_purchase_estimate, 
    cd_credit_rating 
ORDER BY 
    cd_gender, 
    cd_marital_status, 
    cd_education_status, 
    cd_purchase_estimate, 
    cd_credit_rating 
LIMIT 100
